newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.22 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.22 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1095 to the dollar, down from 3.1075 on Tuesday and at 1.8100 to the mark, up from 1.8120, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.22 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, stronger than Tuesday's 3.16 percent fix.
According to the floating parity rate, which changes along with intraday currency moves on world markets, the zloty was fixed at 3.21 percent from parity, up from 3.18 percent.
